name: Seungyeol Ryu
bio: I study surface defect detection and how to choose a classifier for each time series. At UNNEST, I build AI agents that run on private networks.

research.title: An Adaptive Contrastive Learning-Based Robust Surface Defect Detection Model for Noisy Datasets
research.credit: Seungyeol Ryu, Geonwoo Kim, and Jaeyeon Jang
research.summary: Training a surface defect detector when images labeled normal can contain defects.

research.title: Adaptive Model Selection for Time-Series Classification with Language Model
research.summary: Using a language model to choose a classifier for each incoming time series.

research.title: Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning: Development of a Robust Surface Anomaly Detection Model Against Data Noise
research.credit: Seungyeol Ryu, Geon Woo Kim, and Jaeyeon Jang

projects.name: AI assistant for municipal services
projects.summary: Led a municipal-service prototype and designed how it asks for missing details, searches regulations, and handles forms.
projects.case_study: Solideo’s municipal-service prototype. Conversation flow, regulation search, and human review of forms.

visual.alt: The chat sends requests through input checks to the orchestrator, which calls the regulation search, memory, and forms agents.

projects.caption: The prototype’s chat and agent architecture.

projects.name: Metal contamination detection in battery cathode materials
projects.summary: Matched process sensor readings to lab results by production lot and worked on estimating metal concentrations from the sensor data.
projects.case_study: EcoPro BM virtual metrology project. Matching QCP sensor readings to ICP measurements by production lot.

visual.alt: Production lots link QCP sensor readings to lab results. A virtual metrology model uses the sensor readings to estimate ICP measurements.

projects.caption: QCP sensor readings and ICP measurements, matched by production lot.

projects.name: Predicting plate-tip warping during rolling
projects.summary: Extracted the lower edge of steel plates from rolling-line images and used it to help predict warping two passes ahead.
projects.case_study: POSCO plate-warping project. Measuring the lower contour and forecasting warping two rolling passes ahead.

visual.alt: The steel plate analysis workflow with example frames for labeling, segmentation, contour extraction, and prediction.

projects.caption: From the POSCO project presentation. A labeled frame is segmented to extract the plate’s lower edge.

projects.case_study: An NRF-supported project on matching patients with care products. Published application 10-2023-0185772.

visual.alt: A patient profile and care setting guide product comparison. The system lists products that fit both.

projects.caption: Recommendation steps in application 10-2023-0185772.

projects.name: Patient–caregiver matching
